title: AuroraJobs
summary: A recruitment platform that helps university students make their first career moves and connects them with companies hiring junior talent. Multiple funding rounds, 20K+ users, continuous shipping over 5+ years.
problem: University students taking their first career steps and companies looking for junior talent rarely meet in a place built for that stage. Generalist job boards treat both as an afterthought.
audience: University students, companies hiring junior talent, and university career centers.
role: Led engineering. Small product team: product owner/designer, two developers, and me.
responsibilities: Built the product from zero: student profiles, skills and interests assessment, company job posts, matching engine, application flows, and analytics dashboards for university career centers.
Designed and ran the production infrastructure: Kubernetes cluster, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and deploy strategies through multiple product iterations.
Set a lightweight working rhythm (product owner/designer, two developers, and me on engineering) that went from idea to production in weeks.
decisions: Rails monolith for speed across profiles, matching, applications and dashboards.
Small team with pairing and review: ship in weeks, not quarters.
Own the full production stack so product overhauls don't break reliability.
outcomes: Multiple funding rounds and a base of 20K+ users.
Continuous delivery to production for 5+ years.
